newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble firms as funds sought for T-bill buying.
newsitem.headline: Rouble firms as funds sought for T-bill buying.

text.p: The rouble firmed on Wednesday as bank clients, mainly non-residents, were seeking funds to invest in government securities, dealers said.
The Finance Ministry is auctioning 7.50 trillion roubles of 226-day GKO discount Treasury bills and an additional 4.50 trillion rouble 133-day tranche of the bills.
roubles/dollar Jun 4 midday Jun 4 early Jun 3 close
"The dollar eased, definitely on bank client selling, volumes traded were big," Aljba Alliance Bank chief dealer Dmitry Slobodnik said.
He added higher overnight rouble credit rates implied banks were seeking roubles to invest in T-bills.
Another dealer said the rouble was likely to stay at the current level due to support from non-resident T-bill investors.
